Usage: nemar compute list [options]

List your compute jobs

Options:
  --state <state>  Only jobs in this state
  --limit <n>      Jobs per page (1-100, default 25)
  --all            Read every page
  --json           Print the Worker's answer as JSON
  -h, --help       display help for command

Description:
  Lists your compute jobs, newest first, from every front door (this command line, the website and a
  partner site). By default one page of 25; --limit sets the page size (1 to 100) and --all
  reads every page. --state keeps one state (created, uploading, submitted, queued, running, archiving, finished, failed, cancelled, unreported).

Exit codes:
  0  the list was read (an empty list is a list).
  1  you are not signed in, an option is not valid, or the list could not be read.

Examples:
  $ nemar compute list
  $ nemar compute list --state running
  $ nemar compute list --all --json
